method: PCA reconstruction-error detector on healthy rows (RUL >= 100); regimes from KMeans(6) on op_setting_1/2/3. GLOBAL = the single-operating-mode assumption: fit + threshold on the most common regime, applied to all. REGIME-CONDITIONED = per-regime standardization before a shared model. Threshold = 95th pctl of fit recon error. Grouped fit/eval split by unit.
healthy_definition: train rows with rul_target >= 100 cycles (nominal, far from failure)
fp_metric: false-positive rate = fraction of HEALTHY held-out rows flagged anomalous

source.purpose: Typed and ordered C-MAPSS rows with no-look-ahead target handling.

source_query:
SELECT unit, cycle, op_setting_1, op_setting_2, op_setting_3,
       sensor_1, ... , sensor_21, rul_target
FROM novendor_1.telemetry.silver_cmapss
WHERE subset = 'FD004' AND split = 'train';
-- regimes  : KMeans(6) on (op_setting_1, op_setting_2, op_setting_3)
-- healthy  : rul_target >= 100  (fit PCA reconstruction on these)
-- split    : grouped by unit (no unit in both fit and eval) to prevent leakage
-- threshold: 95th percentile of fit reconstruction error

model_card.training_data: C-MAPSS FD004 healthy rows (rul_target >= 100), grouped by unit
model_card.evaluation_data: Held-out FD004 units (grouped split): 11,273 healthy eval rows across 6 regimes
model_card.baseline: GLOBAL single-operating-mode detector (fit + threshold on the most common regime, applied to all)
model_card.validated_method: Per-regime standardization (KMeans(6) on operating settings) before a shared PCA model
model_card.primary_metric: False-positive rate on healthy rows (mean across regimes; worst regime)
model_card.headline: 93.3% mean false-positive reduction (84.3% to 5.7%); worst regime 100% to 10.2% (89.8% reduction)
model_card.caveat: Historical validation on NASA C-MAPSS FD004. This is NOT proof that this PCA model scores live Stargate events; live Stargate detection is a separate transparent rolling-MAD baseline over a recorded capture.
model_card.decision_informed: Whether anomaly detection must be regime-aware (condition on operating mode) before it is trusted to alert operators.

theory: C-MAPSS FD004 spans six operating regimes, so normal sensor behavior differs by regime; a single global reconstruction threshold treats off-regime-but-healthy points as anomalies.
KMeans on the three operating-setting columns separates the operating conditions into approximate regimes.
PCA reconstruction error flags observations that are hard to reconstruct from healthy behavior within the appropriate regime.
A grouped fit/eval split by unit prevents leakage from the same engine appearing in both fit and evaluation.
A 95th-percentile cutoff on fit reconstruction error is a transparent threshold, not a black-box alarm.
The lesson is not that ML magically detects anomalies; it is that you condition the detector on operating regime, or you page operators constantly.
finding: On FD004's 6 operating regimes, a global detector that assumes a single operating mode (calibrated on the most common condition) false-alarms on the others: its reconstruction error is 100% explained by operating condition, and the worst regime flags 100.0% of HEALTHY points (mean 84% across regimes). The error tracks regime, not faults. Per-regime conditioning cuts the worst-regime false-positive rate to 10.2% (90% reduction), the mean to 5.7%, and drops regime-explained variance to 0%.
limitations: C-MAPSS FD004 has no anomaly labels; the metric is false positives on HEALTHY (high-RUL) rows, not detection recall.

Not a strawman: the global baseline is the single-operating-mode assumption (the naive thing — train on the data you have, ignore conditions, exactly the FD001->FD004 generalization failure). A global model that explicitly accounts for all six conditions also avoids the false alarms; the point is that operating-condition awareness is required, and per-regime normalization is the standard, scalable way to get it.
PCA reconstruction stands in for the production detector; the regime-dominance result transfers to any reconstruction model that ignores operating condition.
Six regimes recovered by KMeans on the three operating-setting columns; FD004's conditions are well-separated so this is stable, but it is clustering, not ground-truth condition labels.
